lines: d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Arturo Mayer is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d14: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d14: 🕯️ Arturo Mayer is dead — lockjaw. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d14: What Arturo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d14: "Arturo's gone." Marvin looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Arturo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d14: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Hermann blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Shoulder Check (Level 1). You know exactly where to hit something with your shoulder so it goes where YOU want. Shove a controlled monster 2 tiles — into its friends, away from yours.

d14: 📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.
d14: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Arturo Mayer, 14 days. The mantle passes to Hermann Sanchez.
d14: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Hermann Sanchez, 43 — a Rancher. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d14: The village's quarrel was with Arturo — and Arturo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d14: At the grave, Marvin speaks for Hermann — "Arturo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d14: The fire knew Hermann before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
